page.overview:
Who is Barriara?

She can be awoken by stepping on the music note-shaped buttons on the ground below her in order to wake her up with a song. While the exact arrangement of buttons will differ per game file, the colors of the solution and the tune will always remain the same. Therefore, the sequence will always be dark green, yellow, light blue, blue, dark green, yellow, light blue, and blue, which plays the "" theme.

After being woken up by , , , or , she gives them the and moves out of the way., the is replaced with a random item.}} She also informs the heroes that there's a guarding the entrance to , but regrettably can't help them defeat it because she has to stay in the village to watch over the young prince. Despite her duty to watch over him, she considers the prince to be immature,
